meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: Claude 能控制浏览器自动完成网页导航、表单填写、数据抓取等操作,并在多个步骤之间保留页面状态。
howto.when: 当你说“go to [url]”“click on”“fill out the form”等触发短语,或提出任何浏览器自动化请求时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截个图。
say.note: Claude 会打开该网址,并把页面截图保存到本地。

say.text: 在登录页面填写用户名和密码。
say.note: Claude 会定位登录表单并填入指定内容。

say.text: 抓取当前页面上的所有链接。
say.note: Claude 会从当前页面提取所有链接并返回列表。

howto.what_en: Claude can automate browser tasks like navigation, form filling, and data extraction, while preserving page state between steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like 'go to [url]', 'click on', 'fill out the form', or any browser automation request.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the site and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill in username and password on the login page.
say_en.note: Claude will fill the form with the provided details.

say_en.text: Scrape all links on the current page.
say_en.note: Claude will extract all links from the page.
